import { type Plugin } from "esbuild";
/**
 * Creates an esbuild plugin that copies native .node bindings to the build output.
 *
 * Native Node.js addons (.node files) cannot be bundled by esbuild.
 * This plugin copies them to the build output directory so they can be
 * loaded at runtime via require().
 *
 * @param packageName - The npm package name (e.g., "better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers")
 * @param nodeFileName - The .node file name (e.g., "better_sqlite3.node")
 * @returns An esbuild plugin
 */
export declare function copyNativeBindings(packageName: string, nodeFileName: string): Plugin;
